name: Hyouka no Gen'ya
source:
Main character returns to the hometown after long absence. He visits his old school and hears voice of important girl there, and then her silhouette shows up. This is a story of a sad love that can't be escaped. And the phantom night begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角回到阔别已久的家乡。他回到了原来的学校，听到了那里重要女孩的声音，然后她的身影出现了。这是一个无法逃避的悲伤爱情故事。幻夜开始了。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
